Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: The First Fragments of the Host
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: We have attracted a few gourmands and perverts. They will expect a feast of the senses.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: The Second Fragments of the Host
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Word spreads. Curiosity and appetite will drive strangers to attend our Vitulation.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: The Third Fragments of the Host
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Filthy draggles of the morbid and the inquisitive.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: The Fourth Fragments of the Host
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: The hungry, the greedy, the curious: all these have received our invitation.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: The Fifth Fragments of the Host
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Now the name of the Vitulation is whispered wherever mouths embrace meat.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: The Sixth Fragments of the Host
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: When the time comes, our guests will throng like rats.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: The Host, Assembled
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: We await only the Key-holder, who must open the Kingskin Gate when our Delight enacts the Grail.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: The Host and the Guests
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: When the signal is given, a great Host will assemble, their eyes so wide - their mouths so wide - to feast and be feasted upon - to draw from me the blood of our Delight. Our very Delight shall lead them in their feasting, and the Lady of Wires shall turn her Key.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: The Witnesses: One of Seven
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: A solitary figure, swaying at the Crossroads in the golden light of the Allure, the blue of the Mansus.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: The Witnesses: Two of Seven
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: A Witness-pair, swaying at the Crossroads in the golden light of the Allure, the blue of the Mansus.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: The Witnesses: Three of Seven
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Their faces are blanker than ever, but they have taken each others' hands.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: The Witnesses: Four of Seven
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: The light bleaches them, but by their nature they will dapple as the moment draws near.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: The Witnesses: Five of Seven
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Five witnesses wait for the fruit that will swell, but never ripen.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: The Witnesses: Six of Seven
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: The air is agony. They cannot look away.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: The Cloud of Witnesses
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Seven silent souls softly supplicate shining source.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Shattered Risen
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: A rending force has dragged this corpse back to near-life. When it moves, it crunches like broken glass. Its fists are claw-nests of bone-shards. It won't hold together for long.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Burgeoning Risen
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: The growths of the Wood have encompassed the corpse's organs, swelled its skull like a gourd, twined around its heart. Its eyes are moist with cunning, and it moves with jerky puppet grace. Its bones are rotten wood, and soon it will take root, but until then it will be a swift and subtle servant.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Voiceless Dead
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Sometimes the Dead enter the Mansus by the White Door. At its threshold they lay down their power of speech forever. Call them back to the world, and they will have no voice, but their skins of dust are yours to command.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Caligine
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: At the corners of the Forge, in the bounds of the Mansus, the Glory's fire meets baser elements. Here is a cunning vapour to infect your enemy's dreams.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Raw Prophet
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Sometimes it divides, sometimes it unites, sometimes she speaks words of warning, sometimes he advises on appetite. Its prophecies are confusion, their whispers confound.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Hint
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: The Hinter are most comfortable behind: behind the scenes, behind the mirrors, behind you. They slide under doors and kill with glass, but they cannot survive the gaze of a living mortal.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Percussigant
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: The Percussigant! It loves the sistrum's shiver, it loves the thrum of the tympanos, it recalls with fondness the flaying of Marsyas, and so it will not\n will not\n will not stop dancing.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Maid-in-the-Mirror
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: 'The ascent is glass. The walls are knives. Each step is blood.' The Dead who rest before a new-cracked mirror, who pass through the Peacock Gate, who master the Sharp Stair: those Dead enter the service of the Sun-in-Rags.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: King Crucible
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: 'IN THE DESERT I WAIT IN THE RUINS I BURN - METAL IS WATER - STONE IS WAX - FLESH IS SMOKE - ENTER ME AND BE NO LONGER.'

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Ezeem, the Second Thirstly
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: 'Change me. Change me. Change me harder. Now: my turn.'

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Teresa
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: 'Oh, the world is flat; oh, but it's flat! I won't stay long. I shan't stay long. Tell me a secret.'

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: King Crucible Burns Low
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: King Crucible's fires have sunk to a lesser heat, for now. Blackened traces remain, like the bones of coal.
